title: A PAIR THAT NEVER LINKS SAYS SO
why: coord-06 on 2026-10-21: in a cross-site frame (itch) the player 2 window booted and nothing on screen said why the pair did not link. Now 15 seconds after the pick with nobody in, the status reads player 2 not linked, the title note says it with RETRY, and the Undercroft feed says it once. This is the first of two ships for couch mode on itch; the window bridge follows.
now: If player 2 does not link within 15 seconds, the game says player 2 not linked and offers RETRY.
